articles.title_en: Turning back the clock: Beliefs about gender roles during lockdown
articles.title_cn: 拨回时钟：封锁期间关于性别角色的信念
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of lockdown measures on beliefs about gender roles. We collect data from a representative sample of 1000 individuals in France during the first COVID-19 lockdown in 2020. To measure beliefs about gender roles, we use questions from the 2018 wave of the European Values Study, and match respondents from the two surveys to compare beliefs before and during lockdown. We find evidence that the lockdown period was associated with a shift towards more traditional beliefs about gender roles. The effects are concentrated among men from the most time-constrained households and from households where bargaining with a partner over sharing responsibility for household production was likely to be an issue. Finally, we find correlational evidence that beliefs in equal gender roles increase with household income. Overall, our results suggest that men are more likely to hold egalitarian beliefs about gender roles when these beliefs are not costly for them.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了封锁措施对性别角色信念的影响。我们在2020年第一次COVID-19封锁期间，从法国一个有代表性的1000人样本中收集数据。为了衡量性别角色信念，我们使用了2018年欧洲价值观调查中的问题，并将两次调查的受访者进行匹配，以比较封锁前后的信念。我们发现证据表明，封锁期间与性别角色信念向更传统方向转变有关。这种影响集中在来自时间最紧张的家庭以及可能与伴侣就分担家庭生产责任进行讨价还价的男性中。最后，我们发现了相关性证据，表明平等性别角色信念随家庭收入增加而增强。总体而言，我们的结果表明，当平等性别角色信念对男性不构成成本时，他们更可能持有这些信念。

articles.title_en: Mothers at work: How mandating a short maternity leave affects work and fertility
articles.title_cn: 工作中的母亲：强制短期产假如何影响工作与生育
articles.abstract_en: Switzerland mandated a 14-week paid maternity leave in 2005 when many firms already offered a similar benefit. While the mandate had only small and temporary effects on labor market outcomes of first-time mothers, it raised the share of those having a second child by three percentage points. Women employed in firms with prior paid leave sharply increased their subsequent fertility. In contrast, women employed in other firms did not change their fertility behaviour, but instead saw a persistent increase in their earnings after birth. This pattern of results suggests that firms with pre-mandate leave passed on (some of) their resulting cost-savings to their employees – “trickle down effects” – by making their maternity leave more generous than mandated, hiring temporary replacement workers and/or supporting mothers’ return to work in other ways.
articles.abstract_cn: 瑞士在2005年强制规定14周带薪产假，当时许多公司已经提供类似福利。虽然这项强制规定对初为人母者的劳动力市场结果只有微小且暂时的影响，但它使生育第二个孩子的比例提高了三个百分点。在先前提供带薪休假的公司工作的女性，其后续生育率显著增加。相比之下，在其他公司工作的女性生育行为没有改变，但她们在生育后的收入却持续增长。这种结果模式表明，在强制规定之前已有休假的公司将其（部分）由此产生的成本节约转嫁给员工——“涓滴效应”——通过使产假比强制规定更慷慨、雇佣临时替代工人和/或以其他方式支持母亲重返工作岗位。

articles.title_en: The learning gain over one school year among 15-year-olds: An international comparison based on PISA
articles.title_cn: 15岁学生一学年的学习增益：基于PISA的国际比较
articles.abstract_en: We compare the learning gain over one year of schooling among 15-year-old students in Austria, Brazil, Malaysia, Scotland (United Kingdom) and Singapore. Common metrics for reading, mathematics and science learning, as established by the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA), are used. In order to overcome the limitations of a cross-sectional, single-cohort design, we combine multiple vintages of PISA data and exploit the fact that the testing period in these countries varied over the years. The results show that students’ yearly learning progress around the age of 15 varies from about one-tenth of a standard deviation in students’ test scores in Malaysia to about one-fourth of a standard deviation or more in Austria and Scotland.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了奥地利、巴西、马来西亚、苏格兰（英国）和新加坡15岁学生一学年的学习增益。使用了国际学生评估项目（PISA）所确立的阅读、数学和科学学习的通用指标。为了克服横截面、单队列设计的局限性，我们结合了多个年份的PISA数据，并利用了这些国家测试时间在不同年份有所变化的事实。结果表明，学生在15岁左右的年度学习进步从马来西亚学生测试分数约十分之一标准差到奥地利和苏格兰约四分之一标准差或更多不等。

articles.title_en: Access to language training and the local integration of refugees
articles.title_cn: 语言培训的可及性与难民的地方融入
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether language classes raise refugees’ language proficiency and improve their socio-economic integration. Our identification strategy leverages the opening, closing, and gradual expansion of local language training centers in Denmark, as well as the quasi-random assignment of the refugees to locations with varying proximity to a language training center. First, we show that refugees’ distance from the assigned language training center is as good as random conditional on initial placement. Second, we show that a one-hour decrease in commuting time increases the total hours of class attended by 46 to 71 hours. Third, we use this novel identification strategy to show that 100 additional hours of language class increases fluency in the Danish language by 8–9 percent, post-language training human capital acquisition by 11–13 percent and improve the integration of the refugees in the communities where they were initially placed, as measured by the lower exit rates from those same communities and an almost 70 percent reduction in mobility to the largest, most immigrant-dense cities in Denmark.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了语言课程是否提高了难民的语言能力并改善了他们的社会经济融入。我们的识别策略利用了丹麦当地语言培训中心的开设、关闭和逐步扩张，以及难民被准随机分配到距离语言培训中心远近不同的地点。首先，我们表明，在初始安置条件下，难民与所分配的语言培训中心之间的距离是随机的。其次，我们表明，通勤时间每减少一小时，参加课程的总时数将增加46至71小时。第三，我们利用这一新颖的识别策略表明，额外100小时的语言课程将使丹麦语的流利程度提高8-9%，语言培训后的人力资本获取提高11-13%，并改善难民在最初安置社区中的融入，这通过他们离开这些社区的比率降低以及向丹麦最大、移民最密集城市迁移的流动性几乎减少70%来衡量。

articles.title_en: Trade Unions and the Process of Technological Change
articles.title_cn: 工会与技术变革过程
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how trade unions influence the process of technological change at the workplace level. Using matched employer-employee data, comprising all Norwegian workplaces and working individuals in the period 2000-2014, we exploit exogeneous changes in the tax rules for union members to identify how changes in unionization rates affect the structural composition of occupations within workplaces. Making a distinction between routine and non-routine workers, based on their estimated probabilities of being replaced by automation technologies, we show how labor unions contribute to raising the relative wage of routine workers over non-routine workers. As routine workers on average have lower earnings than non-routine workers, unions thereby contribute to compress wages at the workplace level. The direct implication of this policy is shown to reduce the relative demand for routine workers over non-routine workers in unionized establishments. However, our results also suggest that unions influence the relative demand for routine workers, conditional on relative wages. Our findings thus give some support to bargaining theories where unions force firms off their demand curves.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了工会如何影响工作场所层面的技术变革过程。利用匹配的雇主-雇员数据，涵盖2000-2014年间所有挪威工作场所和在职个人，我们利用工会成员税收规则的 exogenous 变化来识别工会化率变化如何影响工作场所内职业的结构构成。根据工人被自动化技术替代的估计概率，区分常规和非常规工人，我们展示了工会如何有助于提高常规工人相对于非常规工人的相对工资。由于常规工人平均收入低于非常规工人，工会因此在工作场所层面有助于压缩工资。这一政策的直接影响是降低了工会化企业中常规工人相对于非常规工人的相对需求。然而，我们的结果也表明，工会影响常规工人的相对需求，条件是相对工资。因此，我们的发现为工会迫使企业偏离其需求曲线的谈判理论提供了一些支持。

articles.title_en: Performance pay, work hours and employee health in the UK
articles.title_cn: 绩效工资、工作时间与英国员工健康
articles.abstract_en: A large body of research links performance pay to poorer worker health. The mechanism generating this link remains in doubt. We examine a common suspect, that performance pay causes employees to work longer hours in pursuit of higher pay. Using UK data, we demonstrate that performance pay is associated with more work hours and a higher probability of working long hours. Yet approximately two thirds of these differences reflect worker sorting rather than behavioral change. The remaining effects are small except those for labourers. Indeed, controlling for hours of work does not diminish the link between worse self-reported health and performance pay.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量研究将绩效工资与较差的工人健康状况联系起来。产生这种关联的机制仍存疑。我们考察了一个常见的嫌疑因素，即绩效工资导致员工为了追求更高薪酬而延长工作时间。利用英国数据，我们证明绩效工资与更多的工作时间和更长工作时间的高概率相关。然而，这些差异中约有三分之二反映了工人选择而非行为变化。除体力劳动者外，其余影响较小。事实上，控制工作时间并未削弱自报健康状况较差与绩效工资之间的联系。

articles.title_en: Can workers still climb the social ladder as middling jobs become scarce? Evidence from two British cohorts
articles.title_cn: 当中间工作变得稀缺，工人还能攀登社会阶梯吗？来自两个英国队列的证据
articles.abstract_en: The increase in employment polarization observed in several high-income economies has coincided with a reduction in inter-generational mobility. This paper argues that the disappearance of middling jobs can drive changes in mobility, notably by removing a stepping stone towards high-paying occupations for those from less well-off family backgrounds. Using data from two British cohorts who entered the labour market at two points in time with very different degrees of employment polarization, we examine how parental income affects both entry occupations and occupational upgrading over careers. We find that transitions across occupations are key to mobility and that the impact of parental income has grown over time. At regional level, using a shift-share IV-strategy, we show that the impact of parental income has increased the most in regions experiencing the greatest increase in polarisation. This indicates that the disappearance of middling jobs played a role in the observed decline in mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 在几个高收入经济体中观察到的就业极化增加与代际流动性的减少同时发生。本文认为，中间工作的消失可以推动流动性的变化，特别是通过移除那些来自不太富裕家庭背景的人通往高薪职业的垫脚石。利用两个在不同时间点进入劳动力市场且就业极化程度非常不同的英国队列的数据，我们考察了父母收入如何影响初始职业和职业生涯中的职业升级。我们发现，职业间的转换是流动性的关键，且父母收入的影响随时间增长。在区域层面，使用shift-share IV策略，我们表明父母收入的影响在极化增加最大的地区增长最多。这表明中间工作的消失在观察到的流动性下降中发挥了作用。

articles.title_en: Specialists or generalists? Cross-industry mobility and wages
articles.title_cn: 专才还是通才？跨行业流动性与工资
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the association between industrial specialization at the occupation level and job mobility and earnings for low and middle-wage American workers. I propose the concept of industry specificity to capture the degree of industrial specialization of a worker's occupation. I measure industry specificity using an index of industrial concentration of employment (CEI) defined at the occupation-state-year level. Linking this index to individual-level panel data on wages and job transitions, I show that CEI is negatively associated with workers' wages: moving from the first quartile to the third quartile of industry specificity decreases wages by 13 percent. I next examine the mechanisms that explain these findings. I first find that CEI is negatively associated with cross-industry and cross-occupation mobility, that is, workers employed in industry-specific occupations change industry and occupation less frequently than workers in less specific occupations. In addition, I show that occupation-level factors such as skill uniqueness and automatability increase industry specificity; but they cannot entirely explain the negative effect of CEI on wages. Finally, in line with the main results, I provide suggestive evidence that workers in industry-specific occupations are more vulnerable to industry-wide wage shocks compared to their generalist counterparts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了职业层面的产业专业化与美国中低工资工人的工作流动性和收入之间的关联。我提出了产业特定性的概念，以捕捉工人职业的产业专业化程度。我使用在职业-州-年层面定义的产业就业集中度指数（CEI）来衡量产业特定性。将该指数与个人层面的工资和工作转换面板数据联系起来，我发现CEI与工人工资呈负相关：从产业特定性的第一个四分位数移动到第三个四分位数会使工资降低13%。接下来，我考察了解释这些发现的机制。我首先发现CEI与跨行业和跨职业流动性呈负相关，即从事产业特定性职业的工人比从事较低特定性职业的工人更少地更换行业和职业。此外，我表明职业层面的因素，如技能独特性和可自动化性，会增加产业特定性；但它们不能完全解释CEI对工资的负面影响。最后，与主要结果一致，我提供了提示性证据，表明从事产业特定性职业的工人相比通才型同行更容易受到行业范围内的工资冲击的影响。

articles.title_en: Month-of-birth effects on skills and skill formation
articles.title_cn: 出生月份对技能及技能形成的影响
articles.abstract_en: We estimate month-of-birth effects on cognitive and noncognitive skills, as well as factors relevant to skill formation. Our estimates indicate that younger students in a given grade cohort have lower cognitive and noncognitive skills. To shed light on the underlying mechanisms, we also examine children’s time use and interpersonal relationships. We find evidence of compensatory investment in cognitive skills by younger children, however, they are also more likely to have poor-quality relationships with their classmates and teachers, which may harm the long-term development of noncognitive skills. Our findings on skill formation have implications for efficiency and equity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了出生月份对认知和非认知技能以及与技能形成相关因素的影响。我们的估计表明，在给定年级队列中，年龄较小的学生认知和非认知技能较低。为了揭示潜在机制，我们还考察了儿童的时间使用和人际关系。我们发现年龄较小的儿童在认知技能方面存在补偿性投资的证据，然而，他们也更有可能与同学和老师建立质量较差的关系，这可能损害非认知技能的长期发展。我们关于技能形成的发现对效率和公平具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: The economic value of language in China: How important is Mandarin proficiency in the Chinese labor market? A bounding approach
articles.title_cn: 语言在中国经济中的价值：普通话熟练程度在中国劳动力市场中有多重要？一种边界方法
articles.abstract_en: To shed light on the effectiveness of promoting the use of Mandarin, this paper analyses the economic value of Mandarin in the Chinese labor market using data from the 2016 wave of the China Labor-force Dynamics Survey. To address the self-selection issue, we use both an instrumental variable (IV) and nonparametric bounding approaches. Our results show that the overall return on Mandarin proficiency is positive, ranging from 10.5% to 49.9% across the whole sample. A driving mechanism is that workers with a high Mandarin proficiency are more likely to find jobs that match their expertise, which then increases their productivity in the workplace. We also find that the returns are heterogeneous across different subgroups: (1) Women benefit more than men, which suggests that language proficiency can help reduce the gender wage gap; (2) The return on Mandarin proficiency is statistically significant and positive for young and middle-aged workers, but there is not enough evidence for older workers; (3) The return is larger for individuals living in urban areas than those in rural areas. In addition, we find that the IV method cannot be extrapolated to obtain the marginal returns across different treatment groups, as its coefficient is incredibly large, thus overestimating the economic returns on Mandarin proficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了阐明推广普通话的有效性，本文利用2016年中国劳动力动态调查数据，分析了普通话在中国劳动力市场中的经济价值。为了解决自选择问题，我们同时使用了工具变量（IV）和非参数边界方法。我们的结果表明，普通话熟练程度的总体回报为正，在全样本中从10.5%到49.9%不等。一个驱动机制是，普通话熟练程度高的工人更有可能找到与其专业知识相匹配的工作，从而提高他们在工作场所的生产率。我们还发现，不同子群体的回报存在异质性：（1）女性比男性受益更多，这表明语言熟练程度有助于缩小性别工资差距；（2）普通话熟练程度的回报对年轻和中年工人具有统计显著的正向影响，但对老年工人没有足够的证据；（3）城市地区个体的回报大于农村地区。此外，我们发现IV方法不能外推以获得不同处理组的边际回报，因为其系数异常大，从而高估了普通话熟练程度的经济回报。

articles.title_en: Adviser connectedness and placement outcomes in the economics job market
articles.title_cn: 顾问网络联系与经济就业市场中的安置结果
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of social networks in the academic job market for graduate students of Economics. We find that the connectedness of a student’s advisor in the coauthor network significantly improves her job market outcome. We use two identification strategies and find that a) higher Eigenvector centrality of an adviser leads to her student getting placed at a better ranked institution, and b) larger distance between an adviser and an institution decreases the probability that her students are placed there. Our study sheds light on the importance of social connections in a labour market where information frictions regarding job openings are virtually absent.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了社会网络在经济学研究生学术就业市场中的作用。我们发现，学生在合著者网络中顾问的联系度显著改善了其就业市场结果。我们使用两种识别策略，发现：a) 顾问的特征向量中心性越高，其学生被安置在排名更好的机构的可能性越大；b) 顾问与机构之间的距离越大，其学生被安置在那里的概率越低。我们的研究揭示了在信息摩擦几乎不存在的劳动力市场中，社会联系的重要性。

articles.title_en: Does social assistance disincentivise employment, job formality, and mobility?
articles.title_cn: 社会救助是否会抑制就业、工作正规性和流动性？
articles.abstract_en: How do cash transfers affect employment, job formality, and mobility, especially in times of crises and economic recovery? I examine this question in the context of Indonesia’s major unconditional cash transfer (UCT) programmes, rolled out in a targeted manner in response to adverse economic shocks. Identification is based on a generalised difference-in-differences with propensity score matching approach exploiting three waves of nationally representative longitudinal data on household transfer receipts and labour market outcomes. Annual retrospective data in each survey wave allows me to look at immediate effects, potentially important due to the transient nature of the transfers. Consistent with the income and substitution effects, when cash transfers are distributed using a more precise proxy-means test and current, dynamic welfare information, beneficiaries are more likely to adjust their labour supply in order to qualify for or maintain their benefits. Individuals with lower skill levels show a more pronounced response, with a significant decrease in both employment and job formality. The larger effect on job formality highlights the importance of the adjustment margin through the substitution effect associated with the targeting design.
articles.abstract_cn: 现金转移如何影响就业、工作正规性和流动性，尤其是在危机和经济复苏时期？我在印度尼西亚主要无条件现金转移（UCT）项目的背景下考察这一问题，这些项目是针对不利经济冲击而有针对性地推出的。识别基于广义双重差分与倾向得分匹配方法，利用三轮具有全国代表性的纵向数据，涉及家庭转移支付接收和劳动力市场结果。每轮调查中的年度回顾性数据使我能够考察即时效应，由于转移支付的暂时性，这些效应可能很重要。与收入和替代效应一致，当现金转移使用更精确的代理家计调查和当前动态福利信息进行分配时，受益人更有可能调整其劳动供给以符合或维持其福利。技能水平较低的个体表现出更明显的反应，就业和工作正规性均显著下降。对工作正规性的更大影响凸显了与目标定位设计相关的替代效应所导致的调整边际的重要性。

articles.title_en: The effect of preserving job matches during a crisis
articles.abstract_en: It is generally difficult to measure the importance of preserving worker-firm relationships, particularly for low-wage jobs that involve general skills. The COVID-19 pandemic led to the sudden and seemingly temporary disruption of millions of otherwise productive employment relationships around the world. Using novel administrative and survey data from Denmark, we study a policy where firms paid up to 25% of wages to furlough instead of firing workers. We find that aid-taking firms furloughed about 24pp more workers, a large share of whom would have otherwise been laid off, and this had a positive impact on subsequent firm survival, employment growth and sales. Further, we find firms derive value from maintaining ties to low-wage and blue collar workers and that preserving those matches is beneficial to firms, suggesting policies that preserve job matches may help speed-up recovery.

articles.title_en: Between the dockyard and the deep blue sea—Retention and personnel economics in the Royal Navy
articles.title_cn: 在船坞与深蓝大海之间——皇家海军中的人员留任与人事经济学
articles.abstract_en: This paper tackles various issues in personnel economics using the career profiles of British naval officers during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Specifically we ask how pay, promotions, positions, and peers affect worker retention. Random variation in task assignments and job promotions allows us to explore factors that causally impact retention of personnel. We develop a number of key insights: (i) increases in pay raises retention; (ii) promotions influence retention more than money alone; (iii) many experiences in the Navy involve “firm-specific” human capital; (iv) modern/technical positions can threaten retention; and (v) job exits can be contagious. These results collectively indicate that rigid but technologically progressive organizations may face higher losses of human capital. Unless they enhance promotion opportunities and reorganize certain tasks, skilled personnel will leave.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用19世纪末和20世纪初英国海军军官的职业档案，探讨了人事经济学中的各种问题。具体而言，我们研究薪酬、晋升、职位和同僚如何影响员工留任。任务分配和职位晋升中的随机变化使我们能够探索对人员留任产生因果影响的因素。我们提出了几个关键见解：（i）薪酬增加提高留任率；（ii）晋升对留任的影响大于单纯的金钱；（iii）海军中的许多经历涉及“企业特定”人力资本；（iv）现代/技术性职位可能威胁留任；（v）离职可能具有传染性。这些结果共同表明，僵化但技术先进的组织可能面临更高的人力资本损失。除非它们增加晋升机会并重组某些任务，否则熟练人员将会离开。

articles.title_en: Salary history bans and healing scars from past recessions
articles.title_cn: 薪资历史禁令与过去经济衰退留下的伤疤
articles.abstract_en: In a recession, increased competition forces inexperienced job market entrants to accept lower wages than those who start their careers during an economic boom. Despite years of improvement in labor market conditions following a recession, a wage disparity, known as scarring, persists between these cohorts. Recently implemented Salary History Ban laws (SHBs) are intended to reduce wage disparities between advantaged and disadvantaged groups. In this study, I test how these laws affect a unique and often less salient disadvantaged group – scarred workers. For scarred workers who began their careers during a moderate-to-severe recession, or a five percentage point higher state unemployment rate, I find SHBs increase job mobility by 0.6%, hourly wages by 2.65%, and weekly earnings by 5% relative to cohorts who graduated in baseline labor market conditions. These estimates represent a substantial reduction in the original scarring effect and provide a broader understanding of the mechanisms behind both scarring and SHB laws.
articles.abstract_cn: 在经济衰退期间，竞争加剧迫使缺乏经验的劳动力市场新进入者接受比经济繁荣时期开始职业生涯的人更低的工资。尽管衰退后劳动力市场条件多年改善，但这些群体之间的工资差距（称为伤疤效应）持续存在。最近实施的薪资历史禁令法律旨在减少优势群体与弱势群体之间的工资差距。在本研究中，我检验了这些法律如何影响一个独特且往往不太受关注的弱势群体——受伤疤影响的工人。对于在中等至严重衰退期间（或州失业率高出五个百分点）开始职业生涯的受伤疤影响的工人，我发现相对于在基准劳动力市场条件下毕业的群体，薪资历史禁令使工作流动性提高0.6%，时薪提高2.65%，周收入提高5%。这些估计代表了原始伤疤效应的显著减少，并为理解伤疤效应和薪资历史禁令背后的机制提供了更广泛的视角。

articles.title_en: Presence of language-learning opportunities and migration
articles.title_cn: 语言学习机会的存在与移民
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effect of German language-learning opportunities abroad on migration to Germany. We use information about the Goethe-Institut (GI), which promotes the German language worldwide. Our unique dataset covers 69 countries for the period 1977 to 2014. In this multiple-origin and single-destination framework, we estimate fixed-effects models as our basic specification. We find evidence that the number of language institutes of the GI in a country is positively correlated with migration from that country to Germany. To establish causality, we consider Switzerland as an alternative destination, as the number of institutes is exogenous to migration to Switzerland. We find that the number of institutes affects migration to the German-speaking part of Switzerland but not to the French- and Italian-speaking parts. Backed by further extensions, which control for the presence of multilateral resistance, our results point to a causal effect of language-learning opportunities on migration to Germany.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了国外德语学习机会对移民德国的影响。我们使用了歌德学院（GI）的信息，该学院在全球推广德语。我们独特的数据集涵盖了1977年至2014年间的69个国家。在这个多来源、单一目的地的框架中，我们估计了固定效应模型作为基本设定。我们发现证据表明，一个国家中歌德学院语言学院的数量与该国向德国的移民呈正相关。为了确立因果关系，我们将瑞士作为替代目的地，因为学院数量对瑞士移民来说是外生的。我们发现，学院数量影响移民到瑞士的德语区，但不影响法语区和意大利语区。在进一步扩展中，我们控制了多边阻力的存在，我们的结果指向语言学习机会对移民德国的因果效应。

articles.title_en: Education-oriented and care-oriented preschools: Implications on child development
articles.title_cn: 教育导向与照护导向的幼儿园：对儿童发展的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal effect of education-oriented vs. care-oriented preschools on child development. We use a unique quasi-experiment from Japan that exploits plausibly exogenous regional and temporal variation in the relative availability of different preschools. We find that attendance at an education-oriented preschool is associated with significant improvements in mathematical and linguistic achievement that manifest later in adolescence. Positive effects can also be found for socioemotional measures. Ascending marginal treatment effect (MTE) curves suggest an inverse selection pattern: children that are least likely to enroll in the education-oriented preschool gain the most from it. This heterogeneity is mainly due to specific features of education-oriented preschools (i.e., educational orientation, the interaction with parents due to shorter operating hours, and peer effects), while gains from enrollment in care-oriented preschools appear more homogeneous.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了教育导向与照护导向的幼儿园对儿童发展的因果效应。我们利用日本的一项独特准实验，该实验利用了不同幼儿园相对可获得性中看似外生的区域和时间变化。我们发现，就读教育导向的幼儿园与数学和语言能力的显著提高相关，这些提高在青春期后期显现。对社会情感指标也可以发现积极影响。递增的边际处理效应（MTE）曲线表明存在反向选择模式：最不可能入读教育导向幼儿园的儿童从中获益最多。这种异质性主要归因于教育导向幼儿园的特定特征（即教育导向、因运营时间较短而与家长的互动以及同伴效应），而就读照护导向幼儿园的收益则显得更为同质。

articles.title_en: Make your own luck: The wage gains from starting college in a bad economy
articles.title_cn: 创造自己的运气：在经济不景气时开始大学教育所带来的工资收益
articles.abstract_en: Using data for nearly 40 cohorts of American college graduates and exploiting regional variation in economic conditions, we show robust evidence of a positive relationship between the unemployment rate at the time of college enrollment and subsequent annual earnings, particularly for women. This positive relationship is not driven by selection into employment or by economic conditions at the time of labor market entry. It also cannot be explained by differential sorting into college majors or post-graduate education. Up to one third of the effect is accounted for by sorting towards more remunerative locations. The results are consistent with a behavioral change that induces individuals who experience bad economic times at the beginning of their studies to exert more effort toward obtaining higher paying jobs.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用近40个美国大学毕业生队列的数据，并利用经济状况的地区差异，我们展示了大学入学时失业率与随后年收入之间存在正相关关系的稳健证据，尤其是对女性而言。这种正相关关系并非由就业选择或进入劳动力市场时的经济状况所驱动。它也不能通过大学专业或研究生教育的差异分化来解释。高达三分之一的效应可归因于向更高报酬地区的流动。结果与一种行为变化相一致，即那些在学业初期经历经济不景气的个体，会为获得更高薪酬的工作付出更多努力。

articles.title_en: What is the value added by using causal machine learning methods in a welfare experiment evaluation?
articles.title_cn: 在福利实验评估中使用因果机器学习方法增加了什么价值？
articles.abstract_en: Recent studies have proposed causal machine learning (CML) methods to estimate conditional average treatment effects (CATEs). In this study, I investigate whether CML methods add value compared to conventional CATE estimators by re-evaluating Connecticut’s Jobs First welfare experiment. This experiment entails a mix of positive and negative work incentives. Previous studies show that it is hard to tackle the effect heterogeneity of Jobs First by means of CATEs. I report evidence that CML methods can provide support for the theoretical labor supply predictions. Furthermore, I document reasons why some conventional CATE estimators fail and discuss the limitations of CML methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期研究提出了因果机器学习（CML）方法来估计条件平均处理效应（CATEs）。在本研究中，我通过重新评估康涅狄格州的“就业优先”福利实验，考察了CML方法相比传统CATE估计器是否增加了价值。该实验包含正向和负向工作激励的混合。以往研究表明，通过CATEs处理“就业优先”实验的效应异质性较为困难。我报告的证据表明，CML方法可以为理论劳动供给预测提供支持。此外，我记录了某些传统CATE估计器失败的原因，并讨论了CML方法的局限性。

articles.title_en: Are shorter cumulative temporary contracts worse stepping stones? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment
articles.title_cn: 较短的累计临时合同是否更差的垫脚石？来自准自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Temporary employment contracts are often regarded as ‘stepping stones’ for workers’ careers, because they can help inexperienced workers secure a permanent contract. Our study evaluates whether this stepping-stone function is moderated by the contract duration, exploiting a Dutch policy reform that shortened the maximum duration of sequences of temporary contracts with the same employers from 3 years to 2 years. Leveraging a sharp regression discontinuity design and administrative register data, we show that the reform accelerated the transitions of temporary workers to permanent contracts with the same employers, with the effect being strongest among those working for the same employers for 1–2 years. We conclude that the reform brought more job security to temporary workers without impeding the stepping-stone function of their contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 临时雇佣合同通常被视为工人职业生涯的‘垫脚石’，因为它们可以帮助缺乏经验的工人获得永久合同。我们的研究评估了这一垫脚石功能是否受到合同期限的调节，利用荷兰的一项政策改革，该改革将同一雇主连续临时合同的最长持续时间从3年缩短至2年。利用尖锐的断点回归设计和行政登记数据，我们表明该改革加速了临时工人向同一雇主永久合同的过渡，其中在那些为同一雇主工作1-2年的人群中效果最强。我们得出结论，该改革为临时工人带来了更多的工作保障，而没有妨碍其合同的垫脚石功能。

articles.title_en: Tackling misperceptions about immigrants with fact-checking interventions: A randomized survey experiment
articles.title_cn: 用事实核查干预消除对移民的误解：一项随机调查实验
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a randomized online survey experiment to study the impact of fact-checking offers and financial incentives on misperceptions about immigrants. We find that natives overestimate the number of immigrants and the social and economic costs of immigration. Offering a free check of the factual information about immigrants reduces these misperceptions; it becomes more effective when combined with financial incentives. However, more than half of the participants never took up offers to check factual information. Using a model of information search with limited attention, we identify the presence of non-negligible costs of information search and processing, which limits the effectiveness of the fact-checking interventions. Finally, we find that the fact-checking interventions moderately improve natives’ attitudes toward immigrants but affect neither their policy preferences nor giving behavior toward immigrants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项随机在线调查实验，以研究事实核查提供和金钱激励对关于移民的误解的影响。我们发现，本地人高估了移民的数量以及移民的社会和经济成本。提供免费核查关于移民的事实信息可以减少这些误解；当与金钱激励结合时，它变得更加有效。然而，超过一半的参与者从未接受核查事实信息的提供。使用一个具有有限注意力的信息搜索模型，我们识别出信息搜索和处理成本的存在且不可忽视，这限制了事实核查干预的有效性。最后，我们发现事实核查干预适度改善了本地人对移民的态度，但既不影响他们的政策偏好，也不影响他们对移民的给予行为。

articles.title_en: Employers’ willingness to invest in the training of temporary versus permanent workers: A discrete choice experiment
articles.title_cn: 雇主对临时工与永久工培训投资意愿的离散选择实验研究
articles.abstract_en: Various studies have shown that temporary workers participate less in training than those on permanent contracts. This paper investigates whether there is a difference in employer willingness to provide training to temporary vs. permanent workers and estimates the size of these differences under different cost-benefit related conditions. Building on a theoretical framework for employers’ provision of training that includes the major potential sources of cost-benefit differences associated with training investments in employees with different types of employment contracts, we use a discrete choice experiment to estimate the elasticity of a training offer to three attributes affecting employers’ expected net benefits from training investments: (1) the transferability of the skills being trained, (2) the financial contribution of the employee to the training costs and (3) the repayment of training costs when the employee quits early. We find that the effect of the transferability of the training is small and not robust to alternative model specifications. Instead, employers’ lower likelihood of investing in temporary workers is affected by two attributes: a financial contribution to the training costs and a repayment of training costs in case of early quits. Employers’ willingness to invest in temporary workers will particularly increase when introducing a contract clause that workers will repay their training costs when they quit within a year after the training.
articles.abstract_cn: 多项研究表明，临时工参与培训的比例低于永久合同工。本文探讨雇主为临时工与永久工提供培训的意愿是否存在差异，并估计在不同成本收益相关条件下这些差异的大小。基于雇主提供培训的理论框架，该框架涵盖了与不同雇佣合同类型员工培训投资相关的成本收益差异的主要潜在来源，我们采用离散选择实验来估计培训供给对影响雇主培训投资预期净收益的三个属性的弹性：（1）所培训技能的可转移性，（2）员工对培训成本的财务贡献，以及（3）员工提前离职时培训成本的偿还。我们发现，培训可转移性的影响较小，且对替代模型设定不稳健。相反，雇主对临时工投资意愿较低受到两个属性的影响：对培训成本的财务贡献和提前离职时培训成本的偿还。当引入合同条款规定员工在培训后一年内离职需偿还培训成本时，雇主对临时工的投资意愿尤其会增加。

articles.title_en: Best and brightest? The impact of student visa restrictiveness on who attends college in the US
articles.title_cn: 最优秀和最聪明？学生签证限制对美国大学入学的影响
articles.abstract_en: Before the COVID-19 pandemic, student F-1 visa applicants faced a 27 percent refusal rate that varies by time and region. Recent immigration policies have created uncertainty in whether international students will receive their visas. Using data on the universe of SAT takers between 2004 and 2015 matched with college enrollment records, we examine how the anticipated F-1 visa restrictiveness influences the enrollment of international students in the US. Using an instrumental variables approach, we find that a higher anticipated F-1 student visa refusal rate decreases the number of international SAT takers, decreases the probability of sending SAT scores to US colleges, and decreases international student enrollment in the US. The decreases are larger among international students with higher measured academic achievement. We also document academic achievement of international students and show that over 40 percent of high-scoring international SAT takers do not pursue US college education.
articles.abstract_cn: 在COVID-19大流行之前，F-1学生签证申请人的拒签率为27%，且因时间和地区而异。近期的移民政策造成了国际学生能否获得签证的不确定性。利用2004至2015年间所有SAT考生数据与大学入学记录相匹配，我们考察了预期的F-1签证限制如何影响国际学生在美国的入学。采用工具变量方法，我们发现预期F-1学生签证拒签率上升会减少国际SAT考生人数，降低向美国大学发送SAT成绩的概率，并减少国际学生在美国的入学。这些减少在学业成绩较高的国际学生中更为显著。我们还记录了国际学生的学业成就，并显示超过40%的高分国际SAT考生并未选择在美国接受大学教育。

articles.title_en: Understanding the racial employment gap: The role of sectoral shifts
articles.title_cn: 理解种族就业差距：部门转移的作用
articles.abstract_en: The employment rate for Black men worsened significantly relative to White men during the second half of the 20th century. We explore the role of broad sectoral shifts in labor demand over this period in explaining this trend. We first quantify changes in local employment rates and population in response to local labor demand shifts for both groups of workers. We then combine our estimates with a stylized model that incorporates frictional local labor markets and imperfect mobility across markets. Our framework enables us to aggregate local responses while accounting for geographic mobility and regional employment composition. We find that sectoral reallocation can account for at most, one-fifth of the total exacerbation in the employment rate differential between Black and White men over 1970–2010. Out-migration from harder-hit markets, while large, only slightly mitigates the impact of negative labor demand shifts. We also find that most of the predicted change in the employment rate differential is due to differential response rather than differential exposure to sectoral shifts across groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 在20世纪下半叶，黑人男性的就业率相对于白人男性显著恶化。我们探讨了这一时期劳动力需求中广泛的部门转移在解释这一趋势中的作用。我们首先量化了这两类工人群体在地方劳动力需求转移下，地方就业率和人口的变化。然后，我们将我们的估计与一个包含摩擦性地方劳动力市场和不完全跨市场流动性的简化模型相结合。我们的框架使我们能够汇总地方反应，同时考虑地理流动性和区域就业构成。我们发现，部门重新配置最多可以解释1970-2010年间黑人与白人男性就业率差距总恶化的五分之一。从受冲击较大的市场向外迁移虽然规模较大，但仅略微缓解了负面劳动力需求冲击的影响。我们还发现，就业率差距的预测变化大部分是由于群体间的差异化反应，而非对部门转移的差异化暴露。

articles.title_en: Working life and human capital investment: Causal evidence from a pension reform
articles.title_cn: 工作寿命与人力资本投资：来自养老金改革的因果证据
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we analyze if an increase in the working life leads to more human capital investment via on-the-job training. We obtain RDD-estimates from a sharp date-of-birth cut-off, generated by a pension reform that increased the Early Retirement Age (ERA) by three years for many women in Germany. In our preferred specification, we find that this reform causally increased on-the-job training by 4.4 percentage points – a relative increase of 28.8 percent. We explore heterogeneity and additional outcomes and show that this effect is driven by the behavior of women with high initial levels of education. Our results speak to human capital models as well as policies towards extending or shortening working life.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们分析了工作寿命的延长是否通过在职培训导致更多人力资本投资。我们利用一项养老金改革产生的严格出生日期截点获得了RDD估计值，该改革将德国许多女性的提前退休年龄（ERA）提高了三年。在我们的首选规格中，我们发现这项改革因果性地将在职培训提高了4.4个百分点——相对增加28.8%。我们探讨了异质性和其他结果，并表明这一效应是由初始教育水平较高的女性的行为驱动的。我们的研究结果与人力资本模型以及延长或缩短工作寿命的政策相关。
